title: SB2276 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, clarifies that the term "crime of violence" in regard to weapons offenses includes aggravated rape of a child rather than especially aggravated rape of a child. - Amends TCA Title 4; Title 16; Title 33; Title 36; Title 37; Title 38; Title 39; Title 40; Title 49 and Title 70.

provenance.note: Draft dated 2020-02-04, read from the twin HB 2621 (names SB 2276; sponsor Stevens / Curcio). Word swap; the whole instruction sentence is quoted. Caption lists many titles but only 39-17-1301(3) is amended.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1301(3)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1301(3), is amended by deleting the language "especially aggravated rape of a child" and substituting instead "aggravated rape of a child".
